Codebase review 2026-10-05 on main 3b2211a7bba7fb5699bd7fef3f9bb078bb6866a8. Classification: partial.

A desktop file-backed project store and project port exist, so this is not an empty lifecycle foundation. The ticket requires the user-facing New/Open/Save As/Close/Open Recent route, unsaved-close admission, untitled/dirty presentation, and concurrent recent-project safety; those acceptance paths were not demonstrated by a named lifecycle FX suite in the inspected tree. The portability addition also requires platform seams to replace direct desktop APIs. Keep it open until the shell invokes those flows and tests close admission plus two-writer recent-project preservation.

Evidence:
- studio/desktop/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/desktop/platform/FileProjectStore.scala:74
- studio/desktop/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/desktop/runtime/ProjectPort.scala:209
- docs/studio/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md:596

Remaining / next action: Wire lifecycle commands and verify unsaved-close, recent-project locking/merge, and the stated S0.9 portability audit.

Disposition: Keep open.
